title: Resource-Efficient QUBO Formulation for Anchored Currency Arbitrage
abstract: arXiv:2608.15889v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Currency arbitrage (CA) involves trading currencies in cycles to exploit discrepancies in market valuations. Quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) involves minimizing a quadratic cost (energy) function of binary variables. Previous works have explored the use of QUBO to solve CA problems. We build on these previous works by introducing realistic constraints such as beginning cycles from a held currency and accounting for per-transaction trading fees. We show that this formulation requires fewer logical variables (qubits) than previous QUBO encodings in the literature. We derive provably sufficient penalty weights for its constraint terms. We also introduce an exact anchor-gauge reweighting of the exchange rates that compresses the QUBO coefficient range from the rate scale to the arbitrage scale, addressing the finite analog precision of annealing hardware. translated_title: 资源高效的锚定货币套利QUBO建模
translated_abstract: 货币套利（CA）涉及通过循环交易货币以利用市场估值差异。二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）涉及最小化二元变量的二次成本（能量）函数。先前的研究已探索使用QUBO解决CA问题。我们在这些先前工作的基础上，引入了现实约束，例如从持有的货币开始循环以及考虑每笔交易的交易费用。我们表明，该建模比文献中先前的QUBO编码需要更少的逻辑变量（量子比特）。我们推导出其约束项的可证明充分的惩罚权重。我们还引入了汇率的一种精确锚定-标度重加权，将QUBO系数范围从汇率尺度压缩到套利尺度，解决了退火硬件的有限模拟精度问题。我们使用经典模拟展示了该建模的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种更资源高效的QUBO建模方法，通过引入现实约束、减少量子比特需求、推导惩罚权重并压缩系数范围，解决了锚定货币套利问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a more resource-efficient QUBO formulation for anchored currency arbitrage, incorporating realistic constraints, reducing qubit requirements, deriving penalty weights, and compressing coefficient ranges to address hardware precision.
